Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Speed: Playback speed multiplier of the built-in demo scene shown when in1 is unconnected. 1 = normal, 0 = frozen.
Depthmode: Where depth comes from. auto: in2 if connected, otherwise a radial mask. in2: use the in2 TOP. luma: brightness of the colour input. radial: distance from the image centre.
Invertdepth: Flip the depth map so 0 becomes far and 1 near; use when your depth image runs the other way.
Focus: Depth value (0 near to 1 far) that is sharpest. Animate it for a rack focus.
Range: Half-width of the in-focus depth band around Focus, in depth units (0-1). Larger keeps more of the scene sharp.
Falloff: Depth distance beyond the in-focus band over which blur ramps up to full strength. Small = abrupt, large = gradual.
Maxblur: Largest blur radius in pixels (at 720p, scaled with output height) reached at full defocus. 0 disables the depth of field.
Quality: Number of bokeh gather samples per pixel. Higher is smoother but slower; low values show grain or ringing.
Boost: Extra weight given to bright pixels so highlights bloom into visible bokeh discs. 0 = plain blur.
Blades: Number of aperture blades shaping the bokeh polygon. Below 3 gives a round disc.
Bladerot: Rotation of the bokeh polygon in radians (0-6.28). Only visible when Blades is 3 or more.
Modamount: Strength of the in4 modulation CHOP: channel band1 pushes Focus by Modamount * band1 * 0.5 for a rack focus.
Mbactive: Enable motion blur: velocity-directed blur (needs in3) and frame accumulation.
Shutter: Frame accumulation amount (0-0.97): how much of the previous frame is kept each frame. Higher gives longer smear; 0 = none.
Velscale: Multiplier for the in3 velocity (R,G) before blurring. Larger values give longer streaks; 0 disables velocity blur.
Velsamples: Number of samples taken along the velocity direction. More is smoother but slower.
Reset: Pulse: clear the accumulation history so old frames stop smearing.
Showdepth: Debug: show the prepared depth map instead of the result.
Showcoc: Debug: show the focus map, green where in focus and red where blurred.
